SELECT top 1000 right(A.ACID,3) ACID,right(b.ACID,3),A.EOD_DATE,B.EOD_DATE,A.end_EOD_date, B.end_date FROM BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE  A
LEFT JOIN (select  ACID ,EOD_DATE ,max(CONVERT(VARCHAR,end_date,112)) end_date ,BNK_CODE ,SOURCE_CODE from (select ACID ,EOD_DATE ,BNK_CODE ,SOURCE_CODE  
,dateadd(dd,-1,LEAD(EOD_DATE, 1 ,'2100-01-01') OVER (PARTITION BY ACID, BNK_CODE ,SOURCE_CODE ORDER BY EOD_DATE)) as end_date
from BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE  )
c group by ACID ,EOD_DATE, BNK_CODE ,SOURCE_CODE) B ON A.ACID = B.ACID
AND A.BNK_CODE = B.BNK_CODE AND A.SOURCE_CODE = B.SOURCE_CODE AND A.EOD_DATE = B.EOD_DATE
ORDER BY A.ACID, A.EOD_DATE

UPDATE A 
SET END_EOD_DATE = B.end_date
FROM BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE  A
LEFT JOIN (select  ACID ,EOD_DATE ,max(CONVERT(VARCHAR,end_date,112)) end_date ,BNK_CODE ,SOURCE_CODE from (select ACID ,EOD_DATE ,BNK_CODE ,SOURCE_CODE  
,dateadd(dd,-1,LEAD(EOD_DATE, 1 ,'2100-01-01') OVER (PARTITION BY ACID, BNK_CODE ,SOURCE_CODE ORDER BY EOD_DATE)) as end_date
from BUSC.GLD_EODACCTBALTABLE  )
c group by ACID ,EOD_DATE, BNK_CODE ,SOURCE_CODE) B ON A.ACID = B.ACID
AND A.BNK_CODE = B.BNK_CODE AND A.SOURCE_CODE = B.SOURCE_CODE AND A.EOD_DATE = B.EOD_DATE
--ORDER BY A.ACID, A.EOD_DATE
